items.statement: Among adults treated for hip fracture on the unit in 2022 to 2024, mobilisation within 24 hours of surgery is associated with lower odds of a stay longer than 28 days (adjusted odds ratio 0.5 or lower) after adjustment for pre-surgical characteristics.
items.rationale: Need is high because weekend cover depends on it; novelty is moderate given conflicting evidence; feasible within 100 hours with case-control sampling.
items.risks: Residual confounding; an effect too small to detect with 240 notes.

items.statement: The association is present among patients whose delay was due to weekend staffing, a reason unrelated to how unwell they were.
The association is weaker in patients with dementia.

summary: Three hypotheses; h1 selected, h2 as a confounding check, h3 exploratory.
